name: Monopoly Harry Potter
summary: Classic Monopoly on the Hogwarts board: buy, build cottages and castles, mortgage, and outlast everyone.

cards.hp-sort-03: Advance to Flourish and Blotts. If you pass GO, collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-04: Advance to The Burrow. If you pass GO, collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-05: Advance to the nearest magical transport. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.hp-sort-06: Advance to the nearest magical transport. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.hp-sort-07: Advance to the nearest magical service. Throw the dice again and pay the owner ten times the amount thrown.
cards.hp-sort-08: Take the Hogwarts Express. If you pass GO, collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-09: Gringotts pays you a dividend of 50 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-10: Get out of Azkaban free. This card may be kept until needed or sold.
cards.hp-sort-12: Go directly to Azkaban. Do not pass GO, do not collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-13: Magical repairs on your buildings: pay 25 Galleons per cottage and 100 per castle.
cards.hp-sort-14: Speeding on your broomstick: pay a 15 Galleon fine.
cards.hp-sort-15: You are elected chair of the Gobstones Club: pay each player 50 Galleons.
cards.hp-sort-16: Your cauldron loan matures: collect 150 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-02: Gringotts vault error in your favour: collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-04: Sale of potion ingredients: collect 50 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-05: Get out of Azkaban free. This card may be kept until needed or sold.
cards.hp-potion-06: Go directly to Azkaban. Do not pass GO, do not collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-07: Birthday party in the Great Hall: collect 10 Galleons from every player.
cards.hp-potion-09: You inherit from an old wizarding relative: collect 100 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-10: Second prize in the Quidditch tournament: collect 10 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-11: Go to Hagrid's Hut. If you pass GO, collect 200 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-12: Hogwarts tuition and books: pay 50 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-13: Defence Against the Dark Arts scholarship: collect 100 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-14: Magical street repairs: pay 40 Galleons per cottage and 115 per castle.
cards.hp-potion-15: Auction of magical artefacts: collect 100 Galleons.
cards.hp-potion-16: Fine for misuse of magic: pay 100 Galleons.
